fineweb_prompt_tokens.why: fineweb_edu_prompt.txt is ~1.9K chars of rubric = ~450 tokens at 4 chars/token.

fineweb_output_tokens.why: Prompt asks for <=100-word justification + score line.

fasttext_ms_per_doc_core.why: fastText linear classifier on CPU; not benchmarked here.

cpu_core_hour_usd.why: Typical cloud vCPU-hour; no page fetched.

uncertainty_band_share.why: Share of docs a cheap classifier leaves near the keep/drop threshold; tuned per customer.

chars_per_token.why: No public Jev tokenizer. English web text averages ~4 chars/token on BPE tokenizers; live runs use usage.input_tokens instead.
